seeds.text: Truth is a pathless land. No teacher walks it for you — they can only point at the door.
Stillness isn't the absence of movement. It's not identifying with the movement that's already happening.
To observe without evaluating is the rarest form of intelligence. Most "noticing" is just judging in disguise.
The ego is built from problems — without one, it has no shape. That's why peace can feel threatening to it.
Trying to define yourself is like trying to bite your own teeth. The looker can't be the looked-at.

slides.text: WHY PEACE FEELS LIKE A THREAT
slides.composition: A shattered chrome sphere against a deep void, emitting subtle violet light, hinting at hidden tension beneath a fragile calm.

slides.text: Your mind is built to solve. If there's no problem, it invents one to stay in business.
slides.composition: A detailed overhead shot of a complex, glowing chrome circuit board with intricate, self-repairing pathways, conveying constant internal activity.

slides.text: This is why you constantly 'notice' what's wrong. Noticing is often just judging in disguise.
slides.composition: A close-up of a single stylized eye, rendered in polished chrome and reflecting distorted, judgmental glints, framed by subtle VHS lines.

slides.text: And why you try so hard to define yourself. The looker can't bite its own teeth.
slides.composition: Two ghostly, ethereal 90s anime hands reaching towards each other but never quite touching, set against a blurry, prismatic dreamscape, evoking an impossible self-grasp.

slides.text: When things are quiet, the mind gets scared. Peace means it might lose its job.
slides.composition: A full-body chrome figure, hunched in a defensive posture within a vast, silent, and empty cosmic chamber, radiating an anxious stillness.

slides.text: Stillness isn't the absence of movement. It's noticing the movement without becoming it.
slides.composition: A luminous, floating glass orb gently containing swirling, pastel-colored cosmic dust, symbolizing observing internal flux without entanglement.

slides.text: Just here, with what is, without needing to fix it.
slides.composition: A wide shot of a tranquil, reflective liquid silver lake mirroring an amber and violet painterly sky, with a single, small chrome pebble gently resting on the shore.

caption:
Ever wonder why real peace feels almost… unsettling sometimes? It’s not you. Your brain just needs a job. Let's talk about it.
